title: Dr Pepper Dream Vortex
description: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a large black shadowy ghost with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth floating in the center, holding a dripping Dr Pepper can. A translucent purple female spirit with long flowing hair emerges from a swirling rainbow vortex of colorful bubbles and Dr Pepper cans at the bottom. The background is a dark green swirling sky with twisted black branches and multiple floating Dr Pepper signs and cans.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene with a large black shadowy ghost with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth floating in a dark green swirling sky, holding a red Dr Pepper can with condensation. A translucent purple female spirit with long flowing hair rises from a colorful rainbow spiral vortex made of bubbles and Dr Pepper cans at the bottom. Twisted black tree branches, multiple floating Dr Pepper logos and signs in red, a glowing blue neon Dr Pepper sign, dark fantasy atmosphere.
